columns.name: building_id
columns.description: Permanent minted building ID (bld_NNNNN); never reused. Outside keys are in building_xwalk.

columns.name: building_name
columns.description: Name on the asbestos report cover, else the school list or folder name.

columns.name: building_kind
columns.description: school_building, annex, little_school_house, field_house, pool, garage_or_barn, office_or_center, or farm_or_outdoor, from the name.

columns.name: address
columns.description: Street address: the district school list first, else the asbestos report, assessment, or lead folder.

columns.name: zip
columns.description: ZIP code where a source gives one.

columns.name: year_built
columns.description: Year built from the asbestos report cover or the facility assessment.

columns.name: opa_account
columns.description: OPA account of the City parcel the building sits on, when matched; blank otherwise.

columns.name: parcel_address
columns.description: The City's address for that parcel.

columns.name: parcel_owner
columns.description: Owner of that parcel as the City records it.

columns.name: parcel_match
columns.description: The method that supplied the parcel (school_map_point, city_address_overlap, opa_property_address, a geocode rule, same_site_as_<building>, or none).

columns.name: parcel_confidence
columns.description: high: two or more methods agree and no close rival; medium: one address-text match, a School District-owned parcel at the school's map point, or a same-site parcel; low: one weak method (see building_parcel_review); none: no parcel found.

columns.name: parcel_methods
columns.description: All methods that agree on the chosen parcel, comma-separated.

columns.name: parcel_conflict
columns.description: OPA accounts other methods suggested for this building, if any.

columns.name: schools_current
columns.description: school_ids listed at this building in the most recent district list, comma-separated.

columns.name: n_schools_current
columns.description: Number of schools listed at this building in the most recent list.

columns.name: asbestos_items
columns.description: Confirmed or assumed asbestos-containing entries in the latest report's room log (sums codes if the building has several).

columns.name: asbestos_items_damaged
columns.description: Of those, entries with damage recorded at inspection.

columns.name: asbestos_report_sy
columns.description: School year of the asbestos report.

columns.name: lead_components_tested
columns.description: Painted components tested by XRF in the latest full lead-safe survey.

columns.name: lead_components_positive
columns.description: Components the inspector called positive for lead paint.

columns.name: lead_positive_damaged
columns.description: Positive components with damaged paint at assessment.

columns.name: lead_survey_sy
columns.description: School year the lead survey ended.

columns.name: water_outlets_tested
columns.description: Drinking water outlets tested in the latest initial lead-in-water test.

columns.name: water_outlets_above_action
columns.description: Outlets above the district's 10 ppb action level on first sample.

columns.name: water_sample_sy
columns.description: School year of the water sampling.

columns.name: fca_fci_pct
columns.description: Facility condition index of this building from the 2020 assessment (repair cost / replacement value).

columns.name: fca_repair_cost
columns.description: Assessed repair cost in dollars.

columns.name: fca_replacement_value
columns.description: Replacement value in dollars.

columns.name: fca_report_sy
columns.description: School year of the assessment report.
